Callout.Name: Offensive Weapon Reported
Callout.Message: Person reported carrying a weapon in public.
Callout.Advisory: Male on foot, bat or club seen, no victims.

Script.Line: It is a machete and he is walking down the middle of the road with it.
He has not threatened anybody. Everybody has just moved out of his way.
Two cars have gone past him and neither of them stopped.

Lines.Approach: Bat in his hand and no victims yet. He is walking, not running.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
